sub-flow.doc:description: Notifies the event: ACK when sent or skipped; reject without requeue (DLQ) on a permanent failure or after three attempts

set-variable.doc:description: Becomes true when retrying makes no sense (customer missing, MagicBell rejects)

try.doc:description: Any error that reaches this point rejects the message to its DLQ

ee:transform.doc:description: Reads the message body once, before the retries

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- if ((payload is String) or (payload is Binary)) read(payload, "application/json") else payload

until-successful.doc:description: Up to three attempts for transient errors (MagicBell or papi-customers down, 5xx, timeout)

try.doc:description: Permanent errors are not retried: they are flagged and the flow goes on

flow-ref.name: event-dispatch-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Sends the email of this event

on-error-continue.type: APP:CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND, APP:NOTIFICATION_REJECTED, HTTP:UNAUTHORIZED, HTTP:FORBIDDEN, HTTP:BAD_REQUEST, HTTP:NOT_FOUND, HTTP:CLIENT_SECURITY, HTTP:SECURITY
on-error-continue.doc:description: Retrying does not help: flag the message for reject

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'ERROR - Permanent failure on ' ++ vars.eventKind ++ ', rejecting to DLQ: ' ++ (error.errorType.namespace default 'MULE') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default 'ANY') ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]

set-variable.doc:description: Flags the message for immediate reject

choice.doc:description: Rejects on a permanent failure; otherwise ACK

amqp:reject.doc:description: Reject without requeue: the dead-letter exchange sends it to the queue DLQ

amqp:ack.doc:description: Email sent or skipped: the message leaves the queue

on-error-continue.doc:description: Retries exhausted or unreadable event: reject without requeue to the DLQ

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'ERROR - ' ++ (vars.eventKind default 'event') ++ ' failed three times or is unreadable, rejecting to DLQ: ' ++ (error.errorType.namespace default 'MULE') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default 'ANY') ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs why the message goes to the DLQ

amqp:reject.doc:description: Reject without requeue so the message reaches the DLQ

sub-flow.name: event-dispatch-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Routes the event to its email
